title: Misleading through Inconsistency: A Benchmark for Political Inconsistencies Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the gap between precision and recall scores to identify if models have a statistical preference (bias) toward predicting specific inconsistency classes (e.g., Indirect Inconsistency or Factual Inconsistency) over others.

Collecting and reporting the self-reported political views (e.g., left-wing, moderate, right-leaning) of crowd-sourced annotators to estimate potential ideological biases present in the dataset's annotations.
